title: CHORUS: Coverage-Guided Agentic RL and Policy Consolidation for Testbench Stimulus Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.10090v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Testbenches written by large language models can compile and run while leaving entire datapaths idle. We present CHORUS, the first framework to combine coverage-guided agentic reinforcement learning (RL) with policy consolidation for testbench stimulus generation. We train LLM4Cov's final supervised checkpoint to draft testbenches and repair its lowest-scoring draft using simulator feedback, raising CVDP-ECov agentic Pass@1 from 69.2% to 85.5%. Applying the same training to three checkpoints yields similar overall pass rates, yet the policies succeed on different designs. Averaging their weights combines these strengths in a single dense 4B model that reaches 86.7% agentic Pass@1. When simulator rewards select the teacher for each training prompt, the distilled 4B model reaches 88.0%, 13.5 percentage points above DeepSeek-R1 (671B).

translated_title: CHORUS：面向测试平台激励生成的覆盖率引导智能体强化学习与策略整合
translated_abstract: 大语言模型编写的测试平台可能能够编译并运行，但整个数据通路却处于空闲状态。我们提出了CHORUS，这是首个将覆盖率引导的智能体强化学习（RL）与策略整合相结合用于测试平台激励生成的框架。我们训练LLM4Cov的最终监督检查点来起草测试平台，并利用仿真器反馈修复其得分最低的草稿，将CVDP-ECov上的智能体Pass@1从69.2%提升至85.5%。将同样的训练应用于三个检查点后，整体通过率相近，但各策略在不同设计上各有成功。对它们的权重进行平均，可将这些优势整合到一个稠密的4B模型中，达到86.7%的智能体Pass@1。当仿真器奖励为每个训练提示选择教师模型时，蒸馏得到的4B模型达到88.0%，比DeepSeek-R1（671B）高出13.5个百分点。
tldr: CHORUS是首个将覆盖率引导的智能体强化学习与策略整合相结合的测试平台激励生成框架，通过权重平均与奖励引导蒸馏，其4B模型在CVDP-ECov上达到88.0%的智能体Pass@1，超越DeepSeek-R1（671B）13.5个百分点。
en_tdlr: CHORUS is the first framework to combine coverage-guided agentic RL with policy consolidation for testbench stimulus generation, whose distilled 4B model achieves 88.0% agentic Pass@1 on CVDP-ECov, surpassing DeepSeek-R1 (671B) by 13.5 percentage points.
